claims: Transfuse packed red blood cells for severe anemia (hemoglobin 7.1-7.7 g/dL) in the setting of critical illness.
Monitor hemoglobin and hematocrit serially to assess response to transfusion and ongoing blood loss.
Assess and manage hypotension (MAP 57-65 mmHg) with ongoing nicardipine infusion, considering titration or alternative vasoactive therapy.
Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings, monitoring tidal volumes, plateau pressures, and oxygenation given FiO2 70% and PaO2 79-129 mmHg.
Replete potassium given hypokalemia (potassium 3.2-3.4 mEq/L) with intravenous or enteral potassium replacement.
Monitor serum potassium levels after replacement to ensure normalization and avoid overcorrection.
Continue insulin therapy for hyperglycemia (glucose 160-175 mg/dL) with close glucose monitoring per institutional protocol.
Monitor blood glucose frequently (fingerstick or serum) to maintain target range and avoid hypoglycemia.
Assess and manage pain (reported moderate to severe, score 6) using multimodal analgesia, including scheduled acetaminophen and as-needed opioids.
Perform daily assessment of sedation and delirium using Richmond-RAS and CAM-ICU, targeting light sedation (RASS 0 to -1).
